def factor_tail_downside_var_ratio_ewm(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    returns = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    downside_returns = returns.clip(upper=0.0)
    downside_ewm = downside_returns.pow(2).ewm(span=60, min_periods=60, adjust=False).mean()
    total_ewm = returns.pow(2).ewm(span=60, min_periods=60, adjust=False).mean()
    ratio = downside_ewm / total_ewm.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    ratio.name = "factor_tail_downside_var_ratio_ewm"
    return ratio
description: Preserves the parent's core downside variance share mechanism: the fraction of recent squared returns originating from negative days indicates left-tail fragility. Mutation replaces the equal-weight 60-day rolling sum with an exponentially weighted mean of the same horizon, giving more weight to recent stress dynamics while retaining the same economic interpretation. This smoothing targets responsiveness to newly emerging distributional selling without altering the factor's raw, single-stock nature or the none cross-sectional transform.
